Private beta privacy

Business location: Tokyo, Japan.

Your portal data

ChatGPT sign-in supplies a site-scoped user identifier. Your saved itinerary, preferences, bookmarks, and optional history are stored against that identifier. Account data can be exported or deleted in My Trip.

Optional history

History is off by default. If enabled, the portal retains up to 30 recent guide visits or searches. Turning it off deletes that history. Bookmarks are saved only when requested.

AI assistant

When enabled, sending a question requires your confirmation. The question and selected destination, pace, and interest are sent to OpenAI with relevant guide excerpts. Names, saved itinerary text, reading history and bookmarks are not sent. Requests use store:false; provider security and retention policies still apply. Questions and answers are not stored by this portal. Daily per-user request counts remain for abuse prevention.

Local plans

The original trip editor still stores plans in your browser. Importing one into My Trip requires an explicit click and account save. Delete browser plans in the trip editor; deleting portal data does not clear browser storage.

Current limitations

This remains an owner-private beta. No third-party analytics scripts are enabled. External destination links have their own policies. Contact Tokyo Stays KK using the details below for privacy assistance.

Tokyo Stays KK

Operated by Tokyo Stays KK, based in Tokyo, Japan.

2-15-1 Dogenzaka, Shibuya, Tokyo, Japan

book@tokyostays.jp · +81 80-8121-8105

Purposes of use

We use the site-specific account identifier to keep your saved trips and bookmarks separate from other accounts, selected preferences to recommend guides, optional history to show recent activity, and daily AI request counts to limit abuse. Questions are sent to OpenAI only when you confirm the AI consent control.

Privacy requests

You can export or delete portal data in My Trip, edit your preferences, and turn off reading history. Contact Tokyo Stays KK to request access, correction or assistance with deletion. We may need to verify your identity before disclosing personal information.

Service providers

Hosting and authentication use Sites/ChatGPT; account records use the hosting database. AI requests use OpenAI. We do not assert that all processing occurs in Japan. Provider processing locations, transfer arrangements, retention and security terms require review before public release.
